Name: Custom Teddy Bears
Short description:
Fully Personalized Plush Gifts 🧸

Bring your brand, event, or special occasion to life with our custom teddy bears (minimum order: 400 bears).

Design your teddy bears exactly the way you want them:

  • 🧵 Choose size, colors & fabrics to match your theme or brand

  • 🎵 Option to add a pre-recorded sound chip with your song or personal message (plays when the bear is pressed)

  • 👕 Custom logo t-shirt printed with your logo or design

  • 🎀 Accessories available (bows, scarves, outfits and more)

Perfect for:

  • Corporate gifts & brand promotions

  • Fundraisers & school events

  • Holiday giveaways

  • Special campaigns & merchandise

Name: Blank pillow
Short description:
Includes: 2 blank white pillowcases, cardstock, stuffing and instructions. Instructions: Stuff BLANK pillowcase and close zipper. Set aside. Place cardstock into PRINTED (or to be decorated) pillowcase to prevent markers from going through. Decorate printed pillowcases with markers. Insert stuffed pillow, zipper side first into decorated pillowcases and zip closed. Enjoy!

Personalize your pillows! Add your logo or photo to the pillowcase.

Minimum order of 15, plus a $15 setup fee.
